newsitem.title: FAROE ISLANDS: SOCCER-HAT-TRICK FOR MILOSEVIC AS YUGOSLAVIA ROUT FAROES.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HAT-TRICK FOR MILOSEVIC AS YUGOSLAVIA ROUT FAROES.

text.p: Aston Villa striker Savo Milosevic hit a first half hat-trick for Yugoslavia as the Faroes were buried under an avalanche of goals in a World Cup qualifier on Sunday.
Milosevic began the 8-1 rout in the European group six tie with a goal after seven minutes.
His second in the 36th minute was a delightfully executed lob over goalkeeper Jens Knudsen's head.
Milosevic completed his hat-trick on the stroke of halftime when he followed up to score from close range after Knudsen had dived to block a shot from Sinisa Mihajlovic.
The Yugoslavs' other marksmen were Slavisa Jokanovic (2), Predrag Mijatovic, Vladimir Jugovic and Dragan Stojkovic.
